## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why. If it changes mathematical
behavior, state the old behavior and the new behavior explicitly.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor with no behavior change
- [ ] Build, continuous integration, or tooling

## Related issues

Closes #

## Mathematical notes

State the definition, theorem, or algorithm this change implements, and cite
the reference you followed. Note the asymptotic complexity of any new or
changed routine.

## Testing

- [ ] New or updated unit tests accompany the change
- [ ] Property based tests cover the relevant algebraic laws
- [ ] A new algorithm is cross validated against an independent or naive
      implementation on randomized inputs
- [ ] `make test` passes locally

## Quality checklist

- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make type` passes
- [ ] Public routines are annotated and documented, including complexity
- [ ] The changelog entry under Unreleased is updated
- [ ] No long dash characters and no emoji were introduced
- [ ] Public interface changes are backward compatible, or the break is
      documented with a migration note
